headline: Advice from inside the commercial roles.
lede: Northform RGM Advisory works with New Zealand FMCG suppliers on the decisions that actually move margin: pricing, trade investment, portfolio strategy and customer terms.

credentials.caption: In FMCG commercial roles across several grocery categories
Portfolio revenue managed, with the P&L attached
One market understood properly, rather than several understood partly

body:
Most revenue growth management advice comes from one of two places. Either a global consultancy applying a framework built somewhere else, or someone who has read about these decisions without ever having to make one.

Northform is a third option. Twenty-plus years spent inside New Zealand FMCG commercial roles, carrying the number and living with the consequences of pricing and promotional calls made months earlier.

## What that changes

It changes what gets recommended. Advice built from the inside accounts for the things that decide whether a strategy survives: what your team can actually resource, what a retailer will realistically accept, and how a price move lands three months after the deck is closed.

The starting point changes too. We begin with your data (scan, promotional history, customer P&Ls) instead of a framework looking for somewhere to be applied.

## Where we're focused right now

Three questions come up in almost every conversation with New Zealand suppliers at the moment:

- How to take price when every increase invites a volume conversation and a retailer challenge.
- How to cut promotional depth and frequency without handing share to the competitor who doesn't.
- How to structure trade investment when a small number of customers carry most of your volume.

## How we engage

We scope engagements to a specific commercial question rather than selling a retainer by default. Some are a focused diagnostic over a few weeks. Others run alongside a pricing round, a range review or an annual customer negotiation, where the value is in being in the room while the decisions get made.

Most start with a short conversation about what is happening in your numbers, at no cost. If we don't think we can move them, we will say so. That is a faster and more useful answer than a proposal.

start.heading: Tell us what’s happening in your numbers.
start.body: Thirty minutes is usually enough to work out whether there’s something worth pursuing.
